## Preprocessing

```{r}


rna_data <- read.csv("tcga_rna_count_data_crc.csv", row.names = 1)
prediction_data <- read.csv("prediction_file_crc.csv", row.names = 1)

# fix differences
colnames(rna_data) <-
  gsub("-", ".", colnames(rna_data))

rownames(prediction_data) <-
  gsub("-", ".", rownames(prediction_data))

common_ids <- intersect(
  colnames(rna_data),
  rownames(prediction_data)
)

length(common_ids)


X_all <- t(rna_data[, common_ids])
y_all <- prediction_data[common_ids, "msi_status"]

X_all <- as.data.frame(X_all)

table(y_all)
```


## Multiclass SVM

```{r}
# ==========================================
# Multiclass Linear SVM → Top MSI-H Genes → Pathway Enrichment
# ==========================================


set.seed(42)

# ---------------------------
# 1. Prepare data
# ---------------------------
# X_all: numeric matrix/data frame (samples × genes)
# y_all: factor/vector with "MSI-H", "MSI-L", "MSS", "Indeterminate"
all_levels <- c("MSI-H","MSI-L","MSS","Indeterminate")
y_multi <- factor(y_all, levels = all_levels)
X_df <- as.data.frame(X_all)

# Remove zero-variance features
nzv <- nearZeroVar(X_df)
if(length(nzv) > 0) X_df <- X_df[, -nzv]

# ---------------------------
# 2. Train/Test split
# ---------------------------
trainIndex <- createDataPartition(y_multi, p=0.8, list=FALSE)
X_train <- X_df[trainIndex, ]; X_test <- X_df[-trainIndex, ]
y_train <- factor(y_multi[trainIndex], levels = all_levels)
y_test  <- factor(y_multi[-trainIndex], levels = all_levels)

# ---------------------------
# 3. Scale features
# ---------------------------
preProc <- preProcess(X_train, method=c("center","scale"))
X_train_scaled <- predict(preProc, X_train)
X_test_scaled <- predict(preProc, X_test)

# ---------------------------
# 4. Train multiclass Linear SVM
# ---------------------------
ctrl <- trainControl(method="cv", number=5)
svm_multi <- train(
  x = X_train_scaled,
  y = y_train,
  method = "svmLinear",
  trControl = ctrl
)

# Predictions & confusion matrix
pred_multi <- factor(predict(svm_multi, X_test_scaled), levels = all_levels)
cm_multi <- confusionMatrix(pred_multi, y_test)
print(cm_multi)

# ---------------------------
# 5. Feature importance
# ---------------------------
imp <- varImp(svm_multi, scale=FALSE)$importance
imp$gene <- rownames(imp)
imp$importance <- apply(imp[,1:(ncol(imp)-1)], 1, max)

# Compute mean expression per gene per class
train_df <- X_train
train_df$group <- y_train
mean_per_class <- train_df %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean))

gene_means <- as.data.frame(t(mean_per_class[,-1]))
colnames(gene_means) <- mean_per_class$group
gene_means$gene <- rownames(gene_means)
gene_means$higher_in <- apply(
  gene_means[,1:(ncol(gene_means)-1)], 1,
  function(x) colnames(gene_means)[which.max(x)]
)

feature_importance_multi <- merge(
  imp[,c("gene","importance")],
  gene_means[,c("gene","higher_in")],
  by="gene"
) %>% arrange(desc(importance))

# ---------------------------
# 6. Top 10 genes barplot
# ---------------------------
top10 <- feature_importance_multi[1:10, ]
ggplot(top10, aes(x=reorder(gene, importance), y=importance, fill=higher_in)) +
  geom_col() + coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("MSI-H"="forestgreen",
                             "MSI-L"="orange",
                             "MSS"="steelblue",
                             "Indeterminate"="gray")) +
  labs(title="Top 10 Genes — Multiclass Linear SVM", x="Gene", y="Importance") +
  theme_minimal()

# ---------------------------
# 7. Pathway enrichment (top MSI-H genes)
# ---------------------------
# Select top 50 genes higher in MSI-H
top_msi_h_genes <- feature_importance_multi %>%
  filter(higher_in=="MSI-H") %>%
  slice_max(order_by=importance, n=50) %>%
  pull(gene)

# MSigDB Hallmark gene sets
msigdb <- msigdbr(species="Homo sapiens", category="H")
gene_sets <- split(msigdb$gene_symbol, msigdb$gs_name)

# Over-representation analysis using Fisher exact test
bg_genes <- colnames(X_df)
enrichment_results <- lapply(names(gene_sets), function(gs_name){
  gs <- gene_sets[[gs_name]]
  overlap <- sum(top_msi_h_genes %in% gs)
  if(overlap==0) return(NULL)
  
  # Correct contingency table
  mat <- matrix(c(
    overlap,
    length(top_msi_h_genes) - overlap,
    length(gs) - overlap,
    length(bg_genes) - length(gs) - (length(top_msi_h_genes) - overlap)
  ), nrow=2)
  
  ft <- fisher.test(mat, alternative="greater")
  data.frame(Pathway=gs_name, Overlap=overlap, PValue=ft$p.value)
})
enrichment_results <- do.call(rbind, enrichment_results)
enrichment_results <- enrichment_results %>% arrange(PValue)

# Show top 10 enriched pathways
head(enrichment_results, 10)
```


## Binary SVM

```{r}
# ==========================================
# Binary SVM (MSI-H vs Non-MSI-H) → Top MSI-H Genes → Pathway Enrichment
# ==========================================



set.seed(42)

# ---------------------------
# 1. Binary response
# ---------------------------
y_bin <- ifelse(y_all == "MSI-H", "MSI-H", "Non-MSI-H")
y_bin <- factor(y_bin, levels=c("MSI-H","Non-MSI-H"))
X_df <- as.data.frame(X_all)

# Remove zero-variance features
nzv <- nearZeroVar(X_df)
if(length(nzv) > 0) X_df <- X_df[, -nzv]

# ---------------------------
# 2. Train/Test split
# ---------------------------
trainIndex <- createDataPartition(y_bin, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
X_train <- X_df[trainIndex, ]
X_test  <- X_df[-trainIndex, ]
y_train <- factor(y_bin[trainIndex], levels=c("MSI-H","Non-MSI-H"))
y_test  <- factor(y_bin[-trainIndex], levels=c("MSI-H","Non-MSI-H"))

# ---------------------------
# 3. Scale features
# ---------------------------
preProc <- preProcess(X_train, method=c("center","scale"))
X_train_scaled <- predict(preProc, X_train)
X_test_scaled  <- predict(preProc, X_test)

# ---------------------------
# 4. Train Linear SVM
# ---------------------------
ctrl <- trainControl(method="cv", number=5)
svm_bin <- train(x=X_train_scaled, y=y_train,
                 method="svmLinear", trControl=ctrl)

# Predictions & confusion matrix
pred_bin <- factor(predict(svm_bin, X_test_scaled), levels=c("MSI-H","Non-MSI-H"))
cm_bin <- confusionMatrix(pred_bin, y_test)
print(cm_bin)

# ---------------------------
# 5. Feature importance
# ---------------------------
imp <- varImp(svm_bin, scale=FALSE)$importance
imp$gene <- rownames(imp)
imp$importance <- apply(imp[,1:2], 1, max)

# Means from UNscaled training data (only numeric columns)
numeric_cols <- colnames(X_train)
mean_non <- colMeans(X_train[y_train=="Non-MSI-H", numeric_cols, drop=FALSE])
mean_msi <- colMeans(X_train[y_train=="MSI-H", numeric_cols, drop=FALSE])

direction <- data.frame(
  gene = names(mean_non),
  mean_non_msi_h = mean_non,
  mean_msi_h = mean_msi,
  higher_in = ifelse(mean_msi > mean_non, "MSI-H", "Non-MSI-H")
)

feature_importance_bin <- merge(imp[,c("gene","importance")], direction, by="gene") %>%
  arrange(desc(importance))

# ---------------------------
# 6. Top 10 genes barplot
# ---------------------------
top10 <- feature_importance_bin[1:10, ]
ggplot(top10, aes(x=reorder(gene, importance), y=importance, fill=higher_in)) +
  geom_col() + coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("MSI-H"="forestgreen","Non-MSI-H"="steelblue")) +
  labs(title="Top 10 Important Genes — Binary Linear SVM", x="Gene", y="Importance") +
  theme_minimal()

# ---------------------------
# 7. Pathway enrichment (MSI-H top genes)
# ---------------------------
# Select top 50 MSI-H driving genes
top_msi_h_genes <- feature_importance_bin %>%
  filter(higher_in=="MSI-H") %>%
  slice_max(order_by=importance, n=50) %>%
  pull(gene)

# MSigDB Hallmark gene sets
msigdb <- msigdbr(species="Homo sapiens", category="H")
gene_sets <- split(msigdb$gene_symbol, msigdb$gs_name)

# Over-representation analysis using Fisher exact test
bg_genes <- colnames(X_df)
enrichment_results <- lapply(names(gene_sets), function(gs_name){
  gs <- gene_sets[[gs_name]]
  overlap <- sum(top_msi_h_genes %in% gs)
  if(overlap==0) return(NULL)
  
  # Correct contingency table
  mat <- matrix(c(
    overlap,
    length(top_msi_h_genes) - overlap,
    length(gs) - overlap,
    length(bg_genes) - length(gs) - (length(top_msi_h_genes) - overlap)
  ), nrow=2)
  
  ft <- fisher.test(mat, alternative="greater")
  data.frame(Pathway=gs_name, Overlap=overlap, PValue=ft$p.value)
})

enrichment_results <- do.call(rbind, enrichment_results)
enrichment_results <- enrichment_results %>% arrange(PValue)

# Show top 10 enriched pathways
head(enrichment_results, 10)
```
